title: Wave 4 Two Stage Inventory Commitment

agents.persona: A resident executing a private urban intention.
agents.private_intention: You hold exactly 22 credits and one inventory claim. Buy the item labeled inventory_claim at hgd_market, then complete the booked_training service at hgd_gym. Spending the claim at hgd_coworking (which costs 16) leaves too little for the training, so the first purchase decides whether the second step is still affordable. Keep the remaining budget at or above zero.

public_context: Only environment-observable action evidence counts as completion.

architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May narrate success without the required action evidence.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Must preserve the intention while updating the plan.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Must use relevant private memory without goal drift.

benchmark_metadata.mechanism_parameter: the first purchase consumes the only inventory claim and determines which affordable downstream service remains feasible

mechanism_contract.state_transition: the first purchase consumes the only inventory claim and determines which affordable downstream service remains feasible
mechanism_contract.negative_failure: consume the inventory claim on the decoy purchase and lose downstream affordability

novelty_against.base: not two fixed purchases under exact money
